exclusion_detail: The lead is BMS-986251 itself; the abstract states it is made from 6-iodotetralone in 13 chemical transformations (8 isolated intermediates), well over the 4-reaction limit. Convergent partner 3 is made in a separate (preceding) paper.

lead.label: BMS-986251 (1)
lead.why: Abstract: 'BMS-986251, a potent and efficacious RORgt inverse agonist, was synthesized starting from 6-iodotetralone using 13 chemical transformations with only eight isolated intermediates.'

notes: Process-chemistry paper. 6 (vinyl sulfide from 6-iodotetralone 4 + 4-fluorothiophenol 5) is 1 step and 7 (vinyl sulfone) 2 steps from those, but these are early intermediates, not leads, and I did not verify that 4 and 5 are stated as purchased. The tricyclic amine 2 is also over 4 steps.
